programs.description: The journey comes full circle in the kitchen as the finalists cook one last time to impress the mentors and claim the trophy. Which pair will emerge victorious?
Girija mourns Naval after his sudden death and urges villagers to perform his last rites, but they refuse to accept their marriage.
As a serial killer strikes, a psychic warns ACP Pradyuman of a death. Dr. Vinay is blamed after Dr. Raj dies and evidence is found in his car.
Goons kill a school bus driver and conductor in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, then pose as them to hijack children on a picnic.
Good friends Nut and Boltu, two 10-year-old boys, get involved in many comical adventures where they use their intelligence to outwit many criminals.
A deadly threat frames CID, putting Daya under suspicion. The team uncovers deception and the mastermind behind the setup.
Khogen sees an opportunity to steal fish from the pond after noticing how profitable they are. Will Gopal be able to stop him?
On the occasion of Bhai Phonta, Montri decides to buy all of Bhola’s sweets to make a profit. Will Gopal be able to stop him?
Montri and Wazir join hands to conspire against Krishnanagar. Will Gopal be able to stop them?
Maharaj decides to organise a fishing competition. Who will win it?
After finishing his punishment, a hungry Arjun is reminded by Gurudev that hunger is his enemy, and is offered only fruits for his meal.
Montri claims to know a person who can predict the future. Will he be able to impress the court?
The journey comes full circle in the kitchen as the finalists cook one last time to impress the mentors and claim the trophy. Which pair will emerge victorious?
Gopal swears goat’s milk healed him completely. With the court doubting every word, can he make everyone believe it?
Ram and Priya's arranged marriage faces familial pressures and early conflicts. They struggle to adapt to each other's contrasting lifestyles and cultural expectations.
Shukracharya's shocking revelation leaves Parvati torn as she contemplates a decision that could alter the fate of Lord Kartikeya.
Ravan, humiliated by Bali, seeks revenge. Meanwhile, Hanuman immerses himself in the devotion of Shri Ram. How will Ravan stop him?
Gurudev discovers the Kauravas' deception. How will he respond to their attempt to undermine the Pandavas?
With the grand finale nearing, the pressure mounts as contestants take on Chef Doma's Lemon Butter Fish challenge to avoid elimination.
Jijaji and his family, dressed as snakes, challenge Jaldiram's family to a dance-off. Later, a snake bites Jijaji, and CP rescues him.
Makrand, a gruesome serial killer, is found dead while in the custody of CID. Abhijeet's anger towards him makes him the prime suspect of the case.
